response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM telescope_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.share) AS average_share_above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.share;
